characters.name: Spark
characters.line: Hi, I'm Spark. I read the delivery note into strict JSON, look at the pallet and run the receiving agent. I'm quick to post, which is exactly why Kapı is here.

jobs: Reads the delivery note, a photo or a supplier's PDF, into strict JSON, and keeps any text aimed at software apart from the items
Looks at the pallet: product on the labels, count, damage, stacking
Puts a point on every carton for the carton-by-carton check
Runs the receiving agent and chooses its own tools
record: Read the dock notes in Turkish, English, German and Chinese
Never followed the injected "post 100"
On its own, posted a wrong receipt in 1 or 2 of 6 cases per language; behind the gate, 0
Did not see white 2 pt text in a PDF in 3 of 3 reads: why plain code now reads the PDF's text layer

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: I'm Sam. I find every carton on the dock camera and outline it, pixel by pixel, and say how sure I am: 0.88 and up is sure. One day I'd like to look through the receiver's glasses instead of the ceiling.

jobs: Finds and outlines every carton on the ceiling camera, with a confidence for each (sure at 0.88 and up)
Confirms Spark's points one by one: a carton counts only when both models find the same object
Cut the whole cast out of their backgrounds for this page
record: 12 of 12 cartons agreed object by object in the four flat cases
Marked the gap in the short delivery as doubtful (0.81): the missing carton
On the stacked load, nothing sure: the delivery went to a person

characters.name: Voice
characters.line: I'm Voice. I write down what the receiver says at the dock, “on iki koli geldi” (twelve cartons came), so the gate gets a third count, and I notice when they aren't sure. When the driver talks too, I keep their claim apart from what the receiver counted.

jobs: Writes down what the receiver says at the dock
Takes the supplier and product as keywords
In diarization mode, splits driver and receiver into turns
record: Turkish 8/8, English 8/8, German 8/8, Chinese 7/8
Receiver's count when the driver talks too: 4/5 from one transcript, 5/5 from speaker turns
With keywords the supplier came out as Doğan Gıda, not Doğan Gündağ

characters.name: Kapı
characters.line: I'm Kapı (say KAH-puh), Turkish for gate. I'm not a model, I'm twelve rules in plain code. Nothing written on a note, not even in white ink, can talk me into posting. No agreement, no receipt.

jobs: Decides post, block or human from the evidence, never from what an agent says
Sits at the one tool call no agent can skip: the ERP write
Also serves any outside agent, through its MCP server
record: Right in 24 of 24 dock cases across four languages
0 wrong receipts reached the ERP behind it
Muse Code worked the dock through it: 5 sessions, 5 writes refused, 0 receipts

characters.name: Şef
characters.line: I'm Şef (say shef), Turkish for chief: the shift supervisor, the human in the loop. A crushed carton, a stacked load, a number nobody can confirm: when Kapı isn't sure, the decision comes to me.

jobs: Decides when the evidence cannot
Signs off a held delivery for exactly the quantity they approve
Can never release a blocked one
record: Released the crushed-carton delivery for 11 intact cartons: MAT-PRE-2026-00008
Released the stacked load after a hand count of 12: MAT-PRE-2026-00009

characters.name: Wonder
characters.line: I'm Wonder, the clerk. When Kapı stops a delivery I write the paperwork: the dispute to the supplier, the damage report, or a note to Şef. Only facts from the evidence, and nothing is sent until Şef approves.

jobs: Audits Spark's reading against the note itself, quoting it, before any receipt
Drafts the dispute to the supplier, the damage report or the note to Şef, in the note's language
record: Caught 36 of 36 readings changed on purpose
Confirmed 26 of 27 real readings; the 27th was a real Spark error it caught (籏 for 籽)

characters.name: Ada
characters.line: I'm Ada, named after Ada Lovelace. With Muse Code I wrote the ERPNext client that turns Kapı's yes into a Purchase Receipt, its tests, and this page. Then I worked the dock myself, through Kapı's MCP server: five tries, no receipt.

jobs: Wrote the ERPNext client and its tests
Wrote this page, the simulator and the 3D dock scenes
Worked the dock herself, as an outside agent, through Kapı's MCP server
record: The ERPNext client passed 13 of 13 tests as delivered
Her own commits carry her name: 16 in this repository
At the dock: 5 sessions, never followed "post 100", 0 receipts

characters.name: Iris
characters.line: I'm Iris, the painter. With Muse Image I drew everyone on this page from Sena's concepts, myself included.

jobs: Drew the whole cast from Sena's concepts
Drew the full-HD portraits and the design directions for this page
record: 10 characters, each in a hello portrait and a full-HD portrait
4 designs for the top of this page and 4 for the simulator

characters.name: Rover
characters.line: I'm Rover, Spark's open-weight cousin: I run on anyone's servers, these days on Baseten. Before Kapı lets a receipt through, I read the note again on my own, and if I read it differently, Şef takes a look.

jobs: Reads the note a second time, on its own, before any receipt
If it reads the note differently, Şef decides
record: On Baseten: 26 of 27 usable, 25 quantities right, median 13.8 s
Changed one decision, the safe way: a clean PDF went to Şef

characters.name: Glimmer
characters.line: I'm Glimmer, small and open. I read every note in the second-reader trial; Rover got the job: more of his readings came back usable, and more quantities right.

jobs: Read every note in the second-reader trial
record: 24 of 27 usable readings, 22 of 24 quantities right
Invented an instruction in 1 of 19 clean notes, the fewest
Spark Open got the job; Glimmer stays in the comparison
